-- The TARGET is these definitions, which also appear in the context: d15, S2, d3, d4, d16
def d15 : S1 Bool Bool where
  A1 := Unit
  a2 := inferInstance
  A3 := fun _ => Bool
  a4 := fun _ => false
  a5 := fun _ σ x => σ () || x
  a6 := fun σ => σ ()

structure S2 (X Y : Type) where
    B1 : Type
    B2 : Type
    b3 : B1
    b4 : B2
    b5 : B1 → B2 → X → B2
    b6 : B1 → B2 → X → B1
    a6 : B2 → Y

def d3 (P : S2 X Y) (xs : List X) : P.B1 × P.B2 :=
  xs.foldl (fun s x => (P.b6 s.1 s.2 x, P.b5 s.1 s.2 x)) (P.b3, P.b4)

def d4 (P : S2 X Y) (xs : List X) : Y := P.a6 (P.d3 xs).2

def S1.d16 {X Y P : Type} (N : S1 X Y) (v : P → N.D1 → N.D1)
    (xs : List (X × P)) : Y :=
  N.a6 (xs.foldl (fun σ xp => v xp.2 (N.d2 σ xp.1)) N.a4)

For each pair (x, p) and current assignment σ, it first computes N.d2 σ x, whose value at each index n is N.a5 n σ x. divergences.description: S2 is deliberately broader than O’Reilly-Shah et al.’s class of plastic networks. Its weights may stay fixed, or they may change without affecting activity or output. Thus S2 membership alone implies neither the nontrivial parameter change in P-O2 nor the change in input–output mapping described in P-O3. This is consistent with the claimed inclusion.

S2 chooses an update and readout convention not specified in the passages: both next components are computed from the old weight–activity pair and current input, and only activity is read out. A readout that needs weight information must therefore have that information represented in the activity state.

Doerig et al. identify stimulation as another input channel but do not specify its timing or reach. d16 makes the declared modeling choice to apply that channel after each ordinary update, including the last, as an unrestricted function on the resulting state. The passage does not claim that electrodes or TMS can realize every such function.

judgement.summary: d15 is exactly the claimed one-unit example: once a true input occurs, the output stays true through every later input. S2 supports the claimed inclusion rather than an equality of classes, and d16 remains an input–output function of the paired sensory and intervention inputs.
